Laws sit at the top, the regulations issued under them below, and the decisions, tenders and market launches that apply them
below those. Open a branch to see what is under it; each title leads to the dated entry on the [timeline](index.qmd).
The line under a title says how it relates to the one above it. Where a link between two instruments was inferred
rather than read, the line says so.

Three things the tree does not show: amendments that were not read (listed in [method](method.qmd)), instruments outside the
electricity market (natural gas, the Energy Efficiency Law, the Environment Law), and the exact articles most regulations rest on.
